# Version 4.155.0
> **Skia m155 and HarfBuzz update** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews Skia m155 and HarfBuzz 14.4.0 with intentional text-shaping changes. HarfBuzz updates cross-direction mark positioning and glyph-position saturation. This line also retires built-in RAW/DNG decoding and corrects GPU cache cleanup and fontconfig candidate matching.

## Breaking Changes

- **Decode RAW and DNG outside SkiaSharp** — Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of JPEG previews from RAW containers are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode or convert these files with another library before using SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains value 10 for compatibility but no longer indicates codec support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))

## Engine

- **Skia m155** — Advances the engine to milestone m155 while preserving existing rotation-scale text-run bounds behavior. ([#5081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5081))
- **HarfBuzz 14.4.0** — Updates shaping with cross-direction mark positioning changes for DirectWrite/Core Text compatibility, glyph-position saturation, malformed-font crash and hang fixes, and shaping/subsetting performance work. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))

## API Surface

- **OpenType value tags** — Adds documented OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums. Raw OpenType fetch functions remain internal; no Face wrappers are introduced. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU cache cleanup** — Drops uniquely held Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes so later draws cannot reuse those evicted entries for uninitialized textures. ([#5286](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5286))
- **Linux font fallback** — Fontconfig checks family acceptability on the first valid sorted candidate rather than accepting a lower-ranked substitute prematurely. ([#5286](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5286))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0

Updates native HarfBuzz from 14.2.1 to 14.4.0, changing cross-direction mark positioning and glyph-position saturation while fixing malformed-font crashes and hangs. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums; raw fetch functions remain internal without new Face wrappers.

## Release Candidate 1 (October 12, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 corrected Ganesh cache cleanup after failed flushes and fontconfig first-candidate matching.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13...v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8)
